questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}F(s) & = \mathcal{L}\left[t^2e^t\right] - 2\,\mathcal{L}\left[\boldsymbol{w}^t\right] + \mathcal{L}\left[e^t\right]^{\omega} \\& = (-1)^2 \left(\frac{1}{s-1}\right)^{\omega} - 2(-1)\left(\frac{1}{s-1}\right)^{\omega} + \frac{1}{s-1}{}_{\omega} \\& = \frac{2}{\left(s-1\right)^3} - \frac{2}{\left(s-1\right)^2} + \frac{1}{s-1} = \frac{s^2-4s+5}{(s-1)^3} \cdot {}_{s-1}^{\omega}\end{aligned}
